name: The Horn of Xelthos
summary: A note from C asks you to retrieve the Horn of Xelthos from Shadowfang Keep alone. Veenix in the Stonetalon Mountains may help you through the courtyard gate.

sections.title: A Quiet Approach
sections.body: C leaves the note near Pyrewood Village and names Veenix as a contact in the Stonetalon Mountains. The Horn of Xelthos lies somewhere inside Shadowfang Keep, where entering usually calls for backup. C wants the work kept quiet, so you are to go alone and bring the horn back to the dead drop.

faq.q: Who is asking for the Horn of Xelthos?
faq.answer: C leaves a note asking you to retrieve the Horn of Xelthos and return it to the dead drop near Pyrewood Village.

faq.q: Where is the Horn of Xelthos?
faq.answer: The Horn of Xelthos is somewhere inside Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: Why do I have to go alone?
faq.answer: C says the work requires a low profile, so you are to enter Shadowfang Keep alone.
Veenix is C's contact in the Stonetalon Mountains, and may help you get past Shadowfang Keep's courtyard gate.

faq.q: Where do I return the horn?
faq.answer: Return the horn to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village.
